name: Kaina
source:
"I don't want to go out. I'm scared of people outside..."

A boy living with his adoptive father in a mansion on the outskirts of town.

He was abandoned shortly after he was born because of his hair color, and grew up in the facility of the God-Forgotten Conservation Group "Tenkei no Kai".

He was taken in by Jill about two years ago and started living in Uchimori, but he has little interaction with the townspeople.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/getemono/getemono.html]official website[/url]]
